# coef_map

```{r}
coef_map <- c(
  "(Intercept)"   = "Intercept",
  "s.logsize0"    = "Initial size",
  "s.TBF"         = "TBF",
  "s.TSF"         = "TSF",
  "s.P_RA"        = "Cumulative precipitation (annual)",
  "s.sq.P_RA"     = "Cumulative precipitation (annual)²",
  "s.P_RD"        = "Cumulative precipitation (driest month)",
  "s.P_RW"        = "Cumulative precipitation (wettest month)" ,
  "s.P_RH"        = "Cumulative precipitation (hottest month)",
  "s.T_LA"        = "mean temperature (annual)",
  "s.sq.T_LA"     = "mean temperature (annual)²",
  "s.T_LD"        = "mean temperature (driest month)",
  "s.T_LC"        = "min temperature (coldest month)",
  "s.T_LH"        = "max temperature (hottest month)",
  "s.sq.T_LH"     = "Max temperature (hottest month)²",
  "siteB2"        = "Site B2",
  "siteCH"        = "Site CH",
  "siteCM"        = "Site CM",
  "siteGSP-BI"    = "Site GSP-BI",
  "siteGSP-LI"    = "Site GSP-LI",
  "siteIA"        = "Site IA",
  "siteME"        = "Site ME",
  "s.P_RA:s.T_LA" = "Precipitation x temperature (annual)",
  "s.P_RH:s.T_LH" = "Precipitation x temperature (hottest month)"
)

```

"number of fruits" = crep_mod, "number of seedlings per fruit"=recruit_mod "variance in growth" = vargrowth_mod "growth"=growth_mod \# make coefficient plots for vital rate models \## survival

```{r}
sur_model_terms <- terms(survival_mod)

modelplot(list("probability of survival"=survival_mod,"probability of fruiting"=prep_mod, "growth"=growth_mod, "variance in growth" = vargrowth_mod, "number of fruits" = crep_mod,"number of seedlings per fruit"=recruit_mod), 
          coef_map = rev(coef_map), # rev() reverses list order
          coef_omit = "Intercept") + 
          # coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-30, 30)) +
          # color = ) + # use plus to add customizations like any ggplot object
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = .75) # red 0 line


```

#coef table

## coef table with modelsummary
```{r}


mods <- list(
  "Probability of survival" = survival_mod,
  "Growth" = growth_mod,
  "Probability of reproduction" = prep_mod,
  "Number of fruits" = crep_mod,
  "Variance in growth" = vargrowth_mod,
  "Recruit" = recruit_mod
)

modelsummary(
  mods,
  coef_map = coef_map,
  statistic = "std.error",
  stars = TRUE,
  fmt = 2,
  gof_omit = ".*", ## omit the summary statistics
  output = "Legacy effect/figures+tables/coef_table.docx"
)

```

We can't really trust the p values reported for the lmer mods since using a simple Wald t-distribution gives you inaccurate estimates of p values (not accounting for correlation among observation due to the random effect).

## get bootsrapping P values for mixed effect model

#### BootMer generates new samples, then calculate p value by hand
```{r}
lmer_list <- list(growth_mod, crep_mod, recruit_mod, vargrowth_mod)

## define a function to extract fixed effect coefs
mySumm <- function(x) {
  c(getME(x, "beta"), sigma(x))
}

## run bootMer
boot_res <- bootMer(growth_mod, fixef, nsim = 1000, seed = 101)

boot_res$t  ### bootstrapping estimates for each (n=1000) bootstrapping dataset
boot_res$t0 ### original fixed effect coef estimates

p_values <- rbind(
  (1 - apply(boot_res$t < 0, 2, mean)) * 2,
  (1 - apply(boot_res$t > 0, 2, mean)) * 2
)

final_p_values <- apply(p_values, 2, min)

hist(boot_res$t[,2])

```



#### use lmersampler bootstrap_pvals
```{r}
install.packages("lmeresampler")
library(lmeresampler)

gr_subset_R_2 <- 
  TBF_long[which(TBF_long$sur0_1 == 1),] %>%      ## make sure to subset data to only alive plants
  filter_at(vars(logsize1, s.logsize0, s.TSF,s.sq.TSF, s.TBF, site, s.sq.T_RA,s.T_RA, s.P_RA, s.T_RC, 
                 s.T_RD, s.P_RH), all_vars(!is.na(.)))
boot_p_growth <- lmeresampler::bootstrap_pvals(
  growth_mod,
  type = "parametric",
  B = 1000
)


crep_subset_R <- 
  TBF_long %>% 
  filter_at(vars(logcrep1, s.logsize0, TSF, TBF,s.sq.TSF, site, s.T_RA, s.T_RH), all_vars(!is.na(.)))
boot_p_crep <- lmeresampler::bootstrap_pvals(
  crep_mod,
  type = "parametric",
  B = 1000
)

recruit_df <- read_csv("Legacy effect/data/recruit_df_11_24_2025.csv")
recruit_df$rec_perfruit <- recruit_df$num_news / (recruit_df$num_fr + 0.1)
recruit_df$rec_per_logfruit <- recruit_df$num_news / recruit_df$log.fr
recruit_df <- recruit_df %>%
  select(rec_perfruit, rec_per_logfruit, everything())
recruit_subset <- 
  recruit_df %>% 
  dplyr::filter(across(c(rec_per_logfruit, log.fr, TSF, TBF,site), ~ !is.na(.)))
boot_p_recruit <- lmeresampler::bootstrap_pvals(
  recruit_mod,
  type = "parametric",
  B = 1000
)


growth_terms <- attr(terms(growth_mod), "term.labels")
int_terms <- grep(":", growth_terms, value = TRUE)
int_terms_broken <- unique(unlist(strsplit(int_terms, ":", fixed = TRUE)))
main_terms <- growth_terms[!grepl(":", growth_terms)]
logsize1 <- c("logsize1")
gr_all_terms <- unique(c(main_terms, int_terms_broken, logsize1))
Vargrowth_subset <- 
  TBF_long[which(TBF_long$sur0_1 == 1),] %>%      ## make sure to subset data to only alive plants
  filter(across(all_of(gr_all_terms), ~ !is.na(.)))
Vargrowth_subset$vargrowth <- NA
Vargrowth_subset$predgrowth <- NA
Vargrowth_subset$predgrowth <- predict(growth_mod,newdata=Vargrowth_subset)
Vargrowth_subset$vargrowth <-
  (Vargrowth_subset$predgrowth - # variance is equivalent to (predicted-expected)^2
     Vargrowth_subset$logsize1)^2
Vargrowth_subset$log.vargrowth <- log(Vargrowth_subset$vargrowth)
boot_p_vargrowth <- lmeresampler::bootstrap_pvals(
  vargrowth_mod,
  type = "parametric",
  B = 1000
)

#### make a list of bootstrap objects
boot_list <- list(boot_p_growth, boot_p_crep, boot_p_recruit, boot_p_vargrowth)

boot_list[[1]]$coefficients


```
